routing_and_ownership_assessment.complete_only: Existing Vec-returning methods iterate every broker result in ascending ID order and fail on first sorted error; no partial success flattened as complete. Duplicate transactional IDs/contradictory states remain visible in partial method and are concatenated without dedup on complete success.
routing_and_ownership_assessment.discovery: Initial failure is global; after successful discovery each original broker ID receives a success/error slot even after deadline; refreshed metadata does not add new IDs to the initial snapshot.
routing_and_ownership_assessment.error_policy: COORDINATOR_LOAD_IN_PROGRESS14 retries same broker; COORDINATOR_NOT_AVAILABLE15 and NOT_COORDINATOR16 fail that broker, matching retained Java handler; no empty coordinator lookup remains.
routing_and_ownership_assessment.deadline: Outer timeout_at applies one checked absolute deadline to discovery and each broker including reconnect sleep/auth/negotiation/refresh. Internal helpers receive configured relative limits but the outer wrapper bounds awaits. Synchronous parsing is cooperatively scheduled and bounded by local body/count caps, not a demonstrated precise CPU deadline.
routing_and_ownership_assessment.cancellation: No spawned owner tasks. Dropping active roundtrip marks stream closed via existing CloseOnDrop; next idle_expired observes is_closed and reconnects. Opening not-yet-inserted connection drops locally on cancellation. No actual cancellation test executed in this review.
routing_and_ownership_assessment.attempts: At most eight iterations per broker, three Metadata refreshes cumulatively; each connection attempt can itself negotiate API18 and authenticate, then API18 is negotiated again for API66. Eight iterations is not eight wire requests.
routing_and_ownership_assessment.memory_scope: 16MiB is cumulative API66 body bytes checked after transport receive, not a total RSS/heap cap. Existing transport100MiB cap and handshake bodies are separate. Returned listing/string allocations and complete aggregation remain bounded by100000 rows but need honest envelope labeling.
routing_and_ownership_assessment.bootstrap: Discovery has one attempt through existing bootstrap connection. A bootstrap failure does not claim empty cluster success. Existing merge map may retain brokers absent from a later refresh; initial snapshot semantics remains deliberate.
